test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
 

 Strength
 Not a physical quantity
 
 

 Mass
 Physical quantity
 
 

 Weight
 Physical quantity
 
 

 Volume
 Physical quantity
 
 

 

Mass, Weight, Volume all are physical quantities,

Whereas,

Strength is not a physical quantity.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Strength"**.
